guessability_filter.why: a rewriter sees only the question: it can produce domain vocabulary, never a document's UUID/hash/ticket id. Without this filter the oracle adds the gold's own identifier and reaches it trivially -- the first run of this probe was discarded for exactly that contamination

interpretation: one or two gold-specific terms suffice; a rewriter that sees only the question has a plausible chance -- run the reformulation producer before funding cards
scope_limits: ORACLE: the added terms come from the gold text itself. A real rewriter sees only the question, so every distance here is a LOWER bound on what a real producer must achieve.
Rarity is estimated over the 153,602-document Sidecar X sample, not the whole 947k corpus; terms absent from the sample are treated as rarest, which favours the oracle.
Reach into the BM25 top-50 is admission, not delivery: gold still has to survive fusion and the seat cut.
ERB pool-absent cohort on one bed; the semantic class is generated under an explicit anti-lexical instruction.
